verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an applicant-tracking product, since some vendors offer on-premise or open-source deployments, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Recruitee as a hosted SaaS with cloud APIs, webhooks and settings pages. Nothing documents a self-hosted, on-premise or downloadable deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
